mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05) or false alarm rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05) or false alarm rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the industrial production index above 0.5% signals improving manufacturing output, which boosts earnings for cyclicals and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05) or false alarm rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05) or false alarm rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points and a decline in average hourly earnings (PAYEMS) below -0.2% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS falls > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the joint trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05) or false alarm rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) above 5% signals weakening residential investment, which reduces construction-related earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05) or false alarm rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals a deepening demand contraction, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05) or false alarm rate exceeds 50%.
